tellings.difference: Dates the sighting to World War II and places the pursuit in Monte Carlo in the late 1990s; it does not mention the sightings on the way to the Moon.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Jesse Michels relaying, through Aldrin's sister, that Aldrin had a wartime-era sighting, and then James Fox's pursuit and aborted interview.

as_told.title: Buzz Aldrin's WWII sighting per his sister; James Fox pursuit

plain: Buzz Aldrin, the second man to walk on the Moon in 1969, is said to have told his sister that as a fighter pilot in Japan he saw a foo fighter, a glowing ball of light of the kind military pilots reported, and that he saw UFOs on the way to the Moon. Michels passes this on from the UFO investigator James Fox, who got it from Aldrin's sister. In a later episode Michels tells it differently, putting the sighting in World War II, leaving out the trip to the Moon, and describing Fox chasing Aldrin for an interview in Monte Carlo in the late 1990s that never came off.
